accepted.rule: A log query: a selector anchored on a listed label, then its filters
Parse a line before filtering or formatting on its fields
A metric query counts lines over a range, aggregated to the series you want
A rate of matching lines, the top five routes
A percentile of a field, unwrapped from the line
A declared variable is a matcher's whole value, or a |= or != line filter's string
A declared variable as a label filter's value, after a parser
An offset within the server's range is fine

rejected.rule: A selector of regex matchers alone
rejected.error: every stream selector needs an "=" matcher with a value on a label this source lists

rejected.rule: A selector on a label the source does not list
rejected.error: every stream selector needs an "=" matcher with a value on a label this source lists
LogQL does not parse at character

rejected.rule: A log query beside an operator
rejected.error: a log query cannot be an operand of a binary operator

rejected.rule: A range longer than the server allows
rejected.error: is longer than the 7d this server allows

rejected.rule: An offset longer than the server allows
rejected.error: is longer than the 7d this server allows
a negative offset reads past the end of the window

rejected.rule: A variable inside a regex matcher
rejected.error: cannot be used inside a regex or a pattern

rejected.rule: A variable inside a regex line filter
rejected.error: cannot be used inside a regex or a pattern

rejected.rule: A variable as any other string
rejected.error: may appear only as a matcher's whole value

rejected.rule: A variable as a label name or a field
rejected.error: a variable may appear only as a value, not as a label name or a field

rejected.rule: A variable the dashboard does not declare
rejected.error: variable :app is not declared on this dashboard
